sources.sourceScopeDescription: Complete published employee schedule; this threshold disclosure is not a workforce roster or an annual salary-rate table.
notes: The complete published named employee schedule is retained as printed; surname/given-name fields are joined in their source order without inserting punctuation. Positions are published titles, not copied from other years.

The printed control describes employees with remuneration and expenses exceeding $75,000; it is not silently restated as a remuneration-only selection rule. All below-threshold named exceptions remain as published.
Remuneration uses the published pay column; expenses and any expense-inclusive totals remain separate. Dashes and blanks stay missing; explicit zero stays zero. No compiled records are deleted.
